recipes.title: Mediterranean Lemon Roast Chicken Breast
recipes.description: Skinless breast with olive tapenade, feta, light citrus glaze.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a roasting tray with parchment paper.
Mince 2 garlic cloves and zest 1 lemon, then combine with 3 tbsp olive tapenade and 50g crumbled feta cheese in a small bowl.
Pat 300g chicken breast dry with paper towels and season both sides with 1/2 tsp salt and 1/4 tsp black pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering, then sear chicken breast for 3 minutes per side.
Spread the olive tapenade-feta mixture evenly over the seared chicken breast and top with 2 sprigs fresh thyme.
Squeeze juice from 1 lemon into 100ml water and pour into the pan around the chicken, then roast at 200°C for 15 minutes.
Remove chicken from oven and rest for 3 minutes, then transfer to plate and spoon pan glaze over the top.
Serve immediately with the citrus glaze drizzled over the Mediterranean topping.
